adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, `booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0` is only used to compute `isTeamAdminOrOwner`. For non-team bookings (no teamId), it correctly makes both `isTeamAdmin`/`isTeamOwner` return false, and access is then governed by the explicit `isOrganizer` / `isAttendee` checks. Nothing in the diff shows this causing incorrect authorization for non-team bookings; it’s expected that team-role checks don’t apply when there is no team.
